challenge_title: Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: NASA POWER Daily
resources_listed_or_recommended.product: Daily point data: T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, RH2M, WS2M, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, PRECTOTCORR
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: downloaded for Ariquemes-RO, Franca-SP and Varginha-MG; normalized to climate-daily.csv

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: GPM / IMERG
resources_listed_or_recommended.product: IMERG precipitation rate and accumulation; challenge resource page links GPM
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: not in this checkout; NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR is retained as the explicitly labeled rainfall fallback; no cross-source correction was applied
resources_listed_or_recommended.role: preferred satellite rainfall source for the next ingestion

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: SMAP
resources_listed_or_recommended.product: Surface soil moisture and freeze/thaw; challenge resource page links SMAP
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: not downloaded for these example points; use for regional comparison after the data access / product selection step

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: Landsat
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: catalogued; not needed for the reference water-balance run
resources_listed_or_recommended.role: field-scale vegetation stress and bare-soil history

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: MODIS / VIIRS
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: catalogued; not needed for the reference water-balance run

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: SRTM elevation products
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: catalogued; NASA POWER point elevation is recorded; no independent SRTM raster ingested
resources_listed_or_recommended.role: future slope, runoff and erosion context

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: ECOSTRESS
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: catalogued; not required to derive the daily reference ET0 series

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: GRACE / GRACE-FO
resources_listed_or_recommended.product: Regional groundwater and terrestrial-water storage trends
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: catalogued; scale is regional and not used for a municipality-point bucket

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: SoilGrids
resources_listed_or_recommended.product: 250 m gridded texture, pH and soil organic carbon
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: supplemental non-NASA source; downloaded for each IBGE-centroid point and stored by depth
resources_listed_or_recommended.role: mapped soil prior; available water capacity derived with Saxton & Rawls (2006)

resources_listed_or_recommended.name: IBGE municipal boundaries
resources_listed_or_recommended.product: Municipality GeoJSON used only to compute representative area centroids
resources_listed_or_recommended.project_status: downloaded for the three selected municipality codes
resources_listed_or_recommended.role: coordinate index; no map-based field selection

scope_note: O desafio sugere várias fontes e permite combinar observações NASA com dados locais. Esta ingestão baixa as fontes abertas necessárias à demonstração; o catálogo preserva as fontes recomendadas ainda não incorporadas, sem tratá-las como carregadas.
